answer: Identity bonds that decay. Each agent posts a 50 POA bond as the kernel of its identity, an opal that fades 5% each epoch unless honest work renews it. Renewal needs one verified job per epoch; an idle bond slides off its ledge and expires worthless. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA plus 2,500 POA decay each epoch, against a 30,000 POA monthly pool, a losing trade. An honest agent pays once, works once per epoch, keeps its full share.
